about: Search engines a person can pick for the address bar of their own browser (the desktop app's Personal Browser). Words typed there that are not an address open a search on the engine they picked, in their own browser, as in any browser. These are the person's own searches: Octo never opens these links or searches through them, and an engine's own pages may be link-only for Octo (link-only-sites.json). `search` is an https link with exactly one {query}, where the typed words go, URL-encoded. `default` is the engine a person starts with. Keep the list short; add an engine only with a stable public search link.
